
=== WebPanel: Produccion.listarPrensaProducto ===

--- Start (Event) ---
/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */
	Grid.Rows = Page.Rows
	Grid_Empowerer.GridInternalName = Grid.InternalName
	DDO_GridColumnsSelector.GridInternalName = Grid.InternalName
	If &HTTPRequest.Method = GeneXus.HttpMethod.Get
		Do 'LoadSavedFilters'
	EndIf
	ddo_AGExport.TitleControlIdToReplace = BtnAGExport.InternalName
	&AGExportData = new()
	
	&AGExportDataItem = new()
	&AGExportDataItem.Title = ''
	&AGExportDataItem.Icon = ActionExport.Link()
	&AGExportDataItem.EventKey = !'Export'
	&AGExportDataItem.IsDivider = False
	&AGExportData.Add(&AGExportDataItem)
	
	&AGExportDataItem = new()
	&AGExportDataItem.Title = ''
	&AGExportDataItem.Icon = ActionExportReport.Link()
	&AGExportDataItem.EventKey = !'ExportReport'
	&AGExportDataItem.IsDivider = False
	&AGExportData.Add(&AGExportDataItem)
	
	&GAMSession = GeneXusSecurity.GAMSession.Get(&GAMErrors)
	DDO_Grid.GridInternalName = Grid.InternalName
	DDO_Grid.GAMOAuthToken = &GAMSession.Token
	Form.Caption = ' Prensa Producto'
	Do 'PrepareTransaction'
	Do 'LoadGridState'
	If &OrderedBy < 1
		&OrderedBy = 1
		Do 'SetDDOSortedStatus'
	EndIf
	&DDO_TitleSettingsIcons = GetWWPTitleSettingsIcons()
	DDO_GridColumnsSelector.TitleControlIdToReplace = BtnEditColumns.InternalName
	GridPaginationBar.RowsPerPageSelectedValue = Grid.Rows
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

--- Refresh (Event) ---
/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */
	LoadWWPContext.Call(&WWPContext)
	Do 'CheckSecurityForActions'
	Do Case
		Case &ManageFiltersExecutionStep = 1
			&ManageFiltersExecutionStep = 2
		Case &ManageFiltersExecutionStep = 2
			&ManageFiltersExecutionStep = 0
			Do 'LoadSavedFilters'
	EndCase
	Do 'SaveGridState'
	
	If &Session.Get(!'Produccion.listarPrensaProductoColumnsSelector') <> ''
		&ColumnsSelectorXML = &Session.Get(!'Produccion.listarPrensaProductoColumnsSelector')
		&ColumnsSelector.FromXml(&ColumnsSelectorXML)
	Else
		Do 'InitializeColumnsSelector'
	EndIf
	PrensaNombre.Visible = &ColumnsSelector.Columns.Item(1).IsVisible
	InsumoProductoNombre.Visible = &ColumnsSelector.Columns.Item(2).IsVisible
	ComercialProductoNombre.Visible = &ColumnsSelector.Columns.Item(3).IsVisible
	&GridCurrentPage = Grid.CurrentPage
	&GridPageCount = Grid.PageCount
	&GridAppliedFilters = WWP_GetAppliedFiltersDescription(&Pgmname)
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

--- GridPaginationBar.ChangePage (Event) ---
/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */
	Do Case
		Case GridPaginationBar.SelectedPage = !'Previous'
			Grid.PreviousPage()
		Case GridPaginationBar.SelectedPage = !'Next'
			Grid.NextPage()
		Otherwise
			&PageToGo.FromString(GridPaginationBar.SelectedPage)
			Grid.GotoPage(&PageToGo)
	EndCase
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

--- GridPaginationBar.ChangeRowsPerPage (Event) ---
/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */
	Grid.Rows = GridPaginationBar.RowsPerPageSelectedValue
	Grid.FirstPage()
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

--- DDO_Grid.OnOptionClicked (Event) ---
/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */
	Do Case
		Case DDO_Grid.ActiveEventKey = !'<#OrderASC#>' OR DDO_Grid.ActiveEventKey = !'<#OrderDSC#>'
			&OrderedBy.FromString(DDO_Grid.SelectedValue_get)
			&OrderedDsc = iif(DDO_Grid.ActiveEventKey = !'<#OrderDSC#>', true, false)
			Do 'SetDDOSortedStatus'
			Grid.FirstPage()
		Case DDO_Grid.ActiveEventKey = !'<#Filter#>'
			Do Case
				Case DDO_Grid.SelectedColumn = !'PrensaNombre'
					&TFPrensaNombre = DDO_Grid.FilteredText_get
					&TFPrensaNombre_Sel = DDO_Grid.SelectedValue_get
				Case DDO_Grid.SelectedColumn = !'InsumoProductoNombre'
					&TFInsumoProductoNombre = DDO_Grid.FilteredText_get
					&TFInsumoProductoNombre_Sel = DDO_Grid.SelectedValue_get
				Case DDO_Grid.SelectedColumn = !'ComercialProductoNombre'
					&TFComercialProductoNombre = DDO_Grid.FilteredText_get
					&TFComercialProductoNombre_Sel = DDO_Grid.SelectedValue_get
			EndCase
			Grid.FirstPage()
	EndCase
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

--- Grid.Load (Event) ---
/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */
	&Display = "GXM_display"
	If (&IsAuthorized_Display)
		&Display.Link = gestionarPrensaProducto.Link(TrnMode.Display, PrensaProductoId)
	Endif
	&Update = "GXM_update"
	If (&IsAuthorized_Update)
		&Update.Link = gestionarPrensaProducto.Link(TrnMode.Update, PrensaProductoId)
	Endif
	&Delete = "GX_BtnDelete"
	If (&IsAuthorized_Delete)
		&Delete.Link = gestionarPrensaProducto.Link(TrnMode.Delete, PrensaProductoId)
	Endif
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

--- DDO_GridColumnsSelector.OnColumnsChanged (Event) ---
/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */
	&ColumnsSelectorXML = DDO_GridColumnsSelector.ColumnsSelectorValues
	&ColumnsSelector.FromJson(&ColumnsSelectorXML)
	WWPBaseObjects.SaveColumnsSelectorState(!'Produccion.listarPrensaProductoColumnsSelector', iif(&ColumnsSelectorXML.IsEmpty(), '', &ColumnsSelector.ToXml()))
	Refresh
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

--- ddo_ManageFilters.OnOptionClicked (Event) ---
/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */
	Do Case
		Case ddo_ManageFilters.ActiveEventKey = !'<#Clean#>'
			Do 'CleanFilters'
			Grid.FirstPage()
			Refresh
		Case ddo_ManageFilters.ActiveEventKey = !'<#Save#>'
			Do 'SaveGridState'
			SaveFilterAs.Popup(!'Produccion.listarPrensaProductoFilters', &PgmName + !"GridState")
			&ManageFiltersExecutionStep = 2
			Refresh
		Case ddo_ManageFilters.ActiveEventKey = !'<#Manage#>'
			ManageFilters.Popup(!'Produccion.listarPrensaProductoFilters')
			&ManageFiltersExecutionStep = 2
			Refresh
		Otherwise
			&ManageFiltersXml = GetFilterByName(!'Produccion.listarPrensaProductoFilters', ddo_ManageFilters.ActiveEventKey)
			If &ManageFiltersXml.IsEmpty()
				msg('WWP_FilterNotExist')
			Else
				Do 'CleanFilters'
				SaveGridState.Call(&PgmName + !"GridState",  &ManageFiltersXml)
				&GridState.FromXml(&ManageFiltersXml)
				&OrderedBy = &GridState.OrderedBy
				&OrderedDsc = &GridState.OrderedDsc
				Do 'SetDDOSortedStatus' 
				Do 'LoadRegFiltersState'
				Grid.FirstPage()
				Refresh
			EndIf
	EndCase
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

--- ddo_AGExport.OnOptionClicked (Event) ---
/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */
	Do Case
		Case ddo_AGExport.ActiveEventKey = !'Export'
			Do 'DoExport'
		Case ddo_AGExport.ActiveEventKey = !'ExportReport'
			Do 'DoExportReport'
	EndCase
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

--- 'DocmdAgregar' (Event) ---
/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */
	If (&IsAuthorized_cmdAgregar)
		gestionarPrensaProducto.Call(TrnMode.Insert, &PrensaProductoId)
	Else
		msg("WWP_ActionNoLongerAvailable")
		Refresh
	Endif
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

--- Rules (Rules) ---

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */



	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */


=== Transaction: DB.PrensaProducto ===

--- Start (Event) ---
/* Generated by Work With Pattern [Start] - Do not change */
	[web]
	{
	If not IsAuthorized(&PgmName)
		NotAuthorized(&PgmName)
	Endif
	
	&TrnContext.FromXml(&WebSession.Get(!"TrnContext"))
	&Insert_PrensaId.SetEmpty()
	&Insert_InsumoProductoId.SetEmpty()
	&Insert_ComercialProductoId.SetEmpty()
	
	If (&TrnContext.TransactionName = &Pgmname and &Mode = TrnMode.Insert)
		For &TrnContextAtt in &TrnContext.Attributes
			Do Case
				// When inserting with instantiated PrensaId
				Case &TrnContextAtt.AttributeName = !"PrensaId"
					&Insert_PrensaId.FromString(&TrnContextAtt.AttributeValue)
				// When inserting with instantiated InsumoProductoId
				Case &TrnContextAtt.AttributeName = !"InsumoProductoId"
					&Insert_InsumoProductoId.FromString(&TrnContextAtt.AttributeValue)
				// When inserting with instantiated ComercialProductoId
				Case &TrnContextAtt.AttributeName = !"ComercialProductoId"
					&Insert_ComercialProductoId.FromString(&TrnContextAtt.AttributeValue)
			Endcase
		Endfor
	Endif
	
	If &Mode = TrnMode.Delete
		btn_Enter.Caption = "GX_BtnDelete"
		btn_Enter.TooltipText = "GX_BtnDelete"
	EndIf
	}
	/* Generated by Work With Pattern [End] - Do not change */

--- After Trn (Event) ---
/* Generated by Work With Pattern [Start] - Do not change */
	[web]
	{
	If (&Mode = TrnMode.Delete and not &TrnContext.CallerOnDelete)
		WWPrensaProducto()
	Endif
	
	Return
	}
	/* Generated by Work With Pattern [End] - Do not change */

--- Rules (Rules) ---
/* Generated by Work With Pattern [Start] - Do not change */
[web]
{
parm(in:&Mode, in:&PrensaProductoId);

PrensaProductoId = &PrensaProductoId if not &PrensaProductoId.IsEmpty();
noaccept(PrensaProductoId);
noprompt(PrensaProductoId);

PrensaId = &Insert_PrensaId if &Mode = TrnMode.Insert and not &Insert_PrensaId.IsEmpty();
noaccept(PrensaId) if &Mode = TrnMode.Insert and not &Insert_PrensaId.IsEmpty();
InsumoProductoId = &Insert_InsumoProductoId if &Mode = TrnMode.Insert and not &Insert_InsumoProductoId.IsEmpty();
noaccept(InsumoProductoId) if &Mode = TrnMode.Insert and not &Insert_InsumoProductoId.IsEmpty();
ComercialProductoId = &Insert_ComercialProductoId if &Mode = TrnMode.Insert and not &Insert_ComercialProductoId.IsEmpty();
noaccept(ComercialProductoId) if &Mode = TrnMode.Insert and not &Insert_ComercialProductoId.IsEmpty();}
/* Generated by Work With Pattern [End] - Do not change */


=== WebPanel: Produccion.gestionarPrensaProducto ===

--- Start (Event) ---
&BobinaProductoCategoriaNombre = ObtenerConfiguracion.Udp(!'CategoriaBobina')
	&CarreteProductoCategoriaNombre = ObtenerConfiguracion.Udp(!'CategoriaCarrete')
	&AuditTableName = !'PrensaProducto'
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */
	&LoadSuccess = True
	If (&TrnMode = TrnMode.Display)
		OR (&TrnMode = TrnMode.Insert AND SecGAMIsAuthByFunctionalityKey.Udp(!'prensaproducto_Insert'))
		OR (&TrnMode = TrnMode.Update AND SecGAMIsAuthByFunctionalityKey.Udp(!'prensaproducto_Update'))
		OR (&TrnMode = TrnMode.Delete AND SecGAMIsAuthByFunctionalityKey.Udp(!'prensaproducto_Delete'))
		If &TrnMode <> TrnMode.Insert
			&PrensaProducto.Load(&PrensaProductoId)
			&LoadSuccess = &PrensaProducto.Success()
			If not &LoadSuccess
				&Messages = &PrensaProducto.GetMessages()
				Do 'Show Messages'
			EndIf
			If &TrnMode = TrnMode.Display OR &TrnMode = TrnMode.Delete
				PrensaProducto_PrensaId.Enabled = False
				Combo_PrensaProducto_ComercialProductoId.Enabled = False
				Combo_PrensaProducto_InsumoProductoId.Enabled = False
				&IsWithFilter.Enabled = False
			EndIf
		EndIf
	Else
		&LoadSuccess = False
	EndIf
	If &LoadSuccess
		If &TrnMode = GeneXus.TrnMode.Delete
			msg('GXM_confdelete')
		EndIf
	EndIf
	&DDO_TitleSettingsIcons = GetWWPTitleSettingsIcons()
	Do 'LoadComboPrensaProducto_InsumoProductoId'
	Do 'LoadComboPrensaProducto_ComercialProductoId'
	Do 'AttributesSecurityCode'
	PrensaProducto_PrensaProductoId.Visible = False
	PrensaProducto_PrensaNombre.Visible = False
	PrensaProducto_InsumoProductoNombre.Visible = False
	PrensaProducto_ComercialProductoNombre.Visible = False
	wcAuditoria.Object = WWPBaseObjects.AuditHistoryById.Create(&AuditTableName, &PrensaProductoId)
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

--- Refresh (Event) ---
/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */
	Do 'CheckSecurityForActions'
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

--- Combo_PrensaProducto_ComercialProductoId.OnOptionClicked (Event) ---
/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */
	&PrensaProducto.ComercialProductoId.FromString(Combo_PrensaProducto_ComercialProductoId.SelectedValue_get)
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

--- Combo_PrensaProducto_InsumoProductoId.OnOptionClicked (Event) ---
/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */
	&PrensaProducto.InsumoProductoId.FromString(Combo_PrensaProducto_InsumoProductoId.SelectedValue_get)
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */
	&ProductoBaseProductoId = &PrensaProducto.InsumoProductoId
	
	Do 'ClearComercialProducto'

--- Enter (Event) ---
/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */
	If &TrnMode <> TrnMode.Display
		If &TrnMode <> GeneXus.TrnMode.Delete
			Do 'CheckRequiredFields'
		EndIf
		If &TrnMode = TrnMode.Delete OR &CheckRequiredFieldsResult
			If &TrnMode = TrnMode.Delete
				&PrensaProducto.Delete()
			Else
				&PrensaProducto.Save()
			EndIf
			If &PrensaProducto.Success()
				Do 'After_Trn'
			Else
				&Messages = &PrensaProducto.GetMessages()
				Do 'Show Messages'
			EndIf
		EndIf
	EndIf
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

--- &IsWithFilter.Click (Event) ---
Do 'ClearComercialProducto'

--- Rules (Rules) ---
/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */
parm(in:&TrnMode, in:&PrensaProductoId);
/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */


=== Procedure: Produccion.listarPrensaProductoExport ===

--- Source (Source) ---

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */

// Exports the contents of a grid (using the selected order and filters) to an Excel file.
LoadWWPContext.Call(&WWPContext)

Do 'OpenDocument'

&CellRow = 1
&FirstColumn = 1

Do 'LoadGridState'

Do 'WriteFilters'

Do 'WriteColumnTitles'

Do 'WriteData'

Do 'CloseDocument'

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */


Sub 'OpenDocument'

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */

	&Random = Random() * 10000
	&Filename = !"listarPrensaProductoExport-" + &Random.ToString().Trim() + !".xlsx"

	&ExcelDocument.Open(&Filename)
	Do 'CheckStatus'
	&ExcelDocument.Clear()

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

EndSub

Sub 'WriteFilters'

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */

	If not (&FilterFullText.IsEmpty())
		WWP_ExportWriteFilter(&ExcelDocument, true, &CellRow, &FirstColumn, "WWP_FullTextFilterDescription")
		&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + 1).Text = WWPBaseObjects.WWP_Export_SecureText(&FilterFullText)
	EndIf
	If not (&TFPrensaNombre_Sel.IsEmpty())
		WWP_ExportWriteFilter(&ExcelDocument, true, &CellRow, &FirstColumn, "Prensa")
		&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + 1).Text = WWP_Export_SecureText(&TFPrensaNombre_Sel)
	Else
		If not (&TFPrensaNombre.IsEmpty())
			WWP_ExportWriteFilter(&ExcelDocument, true, &CellRow, &FirstColumn, "Prensa")
			&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + 1).Text = WWP_Export_SecureText(&TFPrensaNombre)
		EndIf
	EndIf
	If not (&TFInsumoProductoNombre_Sel.IsEmpty())
		WWPBaseObjects.WWP_ExportWriteFilter(&ExcelDocument, true, &CellRow, &FirstColumn, "Item")
		&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + 1).Text = WWPBaseObjects.WWP_Export_SecureText(&TFInsumoProductoNombre_Sel)
	Else
		If not (&TFInsumoProductoNombre.IsEmpty())
			WWP_ExportWriteFilter(&ExcelDocument, true, &CellRow, &FirstColumn, "Item")
			&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + 1).Text = WWP_Export_SecureText(&TFInsumoProductoNombre)
		EndIf
	EndIf
	If not (&TFComercialProductoNombre_Sel.IsEmpty())
		WWPBaseObjects.WWP_ExportWriteFilter(&ExcelDocument, true, &CellRow, &FirstColumn, "Carrete")
		&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + 1).Text = WWPBaseObjects.WWP_Export_SecureText(&TFComercialProductoNombre_Sel)
	Else
		If not (&TFComercialProductoNombre.IsEmpty())
			WWP_ExportWriteFilter(&ExcelDocument, true, &CellRow, &FirstColumn, "Carrete")
			&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + 1).Text = WWP_Export_SecureText(&TFComercialProductoNombre)
		EndIf
	EndIf
	&CellRow += 2

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

EndSub

Sub 'WriteColumnTitles'

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */

	&VisibleColumnCount = 0
	If &Session.Get(!'Produccion.listarPrensaProductoColumnsSelector') <> ''
		&ColumnsSelectorXML = &Session.Get(!'Produccion.listarPrensaProductoColumnsSelector')
		&ColumnsSelector.FromXml(&ColumnsSelectorXML)
	Else
		Do 'InitializeColumnsSelector'
	EndIf

	&ColumnsSelector.Columns.Sort(!'Order')
	For &ColumnsSelector_Column in &ColumnsSelector.Columns
		If &ColumnsSelector_Column.IsVisible = True
			&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + &VisibleColumnCount).Text = GetMessageText(iif(&ColumnsSelector_Column.DisplayName.IsEmpty(), &ColumnsSelector_Column.ColumnName, &ColumnsSelector_Column.DisplayName))
			&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + &VisibleColumnCount).Bold = True
			&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + &VisibleColumnCount).Color = 11
			&VisibleColumnCount += 1
		EndIf
	EndFor

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

EndSub

Sub 'WriteData'

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */

	For each DB.PrensaProducto
		order PrensaProductoId  when &OrderedBy = 1
		order PrensaNombre  when &OrderedBy = 2 AND &OrderedDsc = False
		order (PrensaNombre)  when &OrderedBy = 2 AND &OrderedDsc = True
		order InsumoProductoNombre  when &OrderedBy = 3 AND &OrderedDsc = False
		order (InsumoProductoNombre)  when &OrderedBy = 3 AND &OrderedDsc = True
		order ComercialProductoNombre  when &OrderedBy = 4 AND &OrderedDsc = False
		order (ComercialProductoNombre)  when &OrderedBy = 4 AND &OrderedDsc = True
		
		using Produccion.listarPrensaProductoDS(&FilterFullText, &TFPrensaNombre, &TFPrensaNombre_Sel, &TFInsumoProductoNombre, &TFInsumoProductoNombre_Sel, &TFComercialProductoNombre
					, &TFComercialProductoNombre_Sel)

		// Write cell values
		&CellRow += 1
		
		Do 'BeforeWriteLine'
		&VisibleColumnCount = 0
		For &ColumnsSelector_Column in &ColumnsSelector.Columns
			If &ColumnsSelector_Column.IsVisible = True
				Do Case
					Case &ColumnsSelector_Column.ColumnName = !'PrensaNombre'
						&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + &VisibleColumnCount).Text = WWP_Export_SecureText(PrensaNombre)
					Case &ColumnsSelector_Column.ColumnName = !'InsumoProductoNombre'
						&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + &VisibleColumnCount).Text = WWP_Export_SecureText(InsumoProductoNombre)
					Case &ColumnsSelector_Column.ColumnName = !'ComercialProductoNombre'
						&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + &VisibleColumnCount).Text = WWP_Export_SecureText(ComercialProductoNombre)
				EndCase
				&VisibleColumnCount += 1
			EndIf
		EndFor		
		
		Do 'AfterWriteLine'

	Endfor

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

EndSub

Sub 'CloseDocument'

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */

	&ExcelDocument.Save()
	Do 'CheckStatus'
	&ExcelDocument.Close()

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

EndSub

Sub 'CheckStatus'

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */

	If (&ExcelDocument.ErrCode <> 0)
		&Filename = ""
		&ErrorMessage = &ExcelDocument.ErrDescription
		&ExcelDocument.Close()
		Return
	EndIf

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

EndSub

Sub 'InitializeColumnsSelector'

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */

	&ColumnsSelector = new WWPColumnsSelector()
	WWP_ColumnsSelector_Add(&ColumnsSelector, !"PrensaNombre", '', !'Prensa', True, '')
	WWP_ColumnsSelector_Add(&ColumnsSelector, !"InsumoProductoNombre", '', !'Item', True, '')
	WWP_ColumnsSelector_Add(&ColumnsSelector, !"ComercialProductoNombre", '', !'Carrete', True, '')
		
	&UserCustomValue = LoadColumnsSelectorState.Udp(!'Produccion.listarPrensaProductoColumnsSelector')
	If not(&UserCustomValue.IsEmpty())
		&ColumnsSelectorAux.FromXml(&UserCustomValue)
		WWP_ColumnSelector_UpdateColumns(&ColumnsSelectorAux, &ColumnsSelector)
	EndIf

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

EndSub

Sub 'LoadGridState'

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */

	// Load grid state from session.
	If &Session.Get(!"Produccion.listarPrensaProductoGridState") = !""
		&GridState.FromXml(LoadGridState.Udp(!"Produccion.listarPrensaProductoGridState"))
	Else
		&GridState.FromXml(&Session.Get(!"Produccion.listarPrensaProductoGridState"))
	Endif	

	&OrderedBy = &GridState.OrderedBy
	&OrderedDsc = &GridState.OrderedDsc

	For &GridStateFilterValue in &GridState.FilterValues
		Do Case
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"FILTERFULLTEXT"
				&FilterFullText.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFPRENSANOMBRE"
				&TFPrensaNombre.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFPRENSANOMBRE_SEL"
				&TFPrensaNombre_Sel.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFINSUMOPRODUCTONOMBRE"
				&TFInsumoProductoNombre.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFINSUMOPRODUCTONOMBRE_SEL"
				&TFInsumoProductoNombre_Sel.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFCOMERCIALPRODUCTONOMBRE"
				&TFComercialProductoNombre.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFCOMERCIALPRODUCTONOMBRE_SEL"
				&TFComercialProductoNombre_Sel.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
		EndCase
	EndFor

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

EndSub

Sub 'BeforeWriteLine'

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */



	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

EndSub

Sub 'AfterWriteLine'

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */



	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

EndSub

--- Rules (Rules) ---

=== Procedure: Produccion.listarPrensaProductoExportReport ===

--- Source (Source) ---

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */

// Exports the contents of a grid (using the selected order and filters) to a PDF file.
&IsAuthorized = SecGAMIsAuthByFunctionalityKey.Udp(!'listarprensaproducto_Execute') 
If &IsAuthorized

	WWPBaseObjects.LoadWWPContext.Call(&WWPContext)

Do 'LoadGridState'

&Title = "Prensa Producto List"

//Report Template Source
	Header
		&AppName = "DVelop Software Solutions"
		&Phone = !"+1 550 8923"
		&Mail = !"info@mail.com"
		&Website = !"http://www.web.com"
		&AddressLine1 = !"French Boulevard 2859"
		&AddressLine2 = !"Downtown"
		&AddressLine3 = !"Paris, France"
		Print printTitle
	End 
	Footer
		&PageInfo = "Page: " + &Page.ToString().Trim()
		&DateInfo = "Date: " + &Today.ToFormattedString()
		Print printFooter
	End

	Do 'PrintFilters'

	Do 'PrintColumnTitles'

	Do 'PrintData'

	Do 'PrintFooter'

EndIf

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */


Sub 'PrintFilters'

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */

	If not &FilterFullText.IsEmpty()
		print printBlockFilterFilterFullText
	EndIf
	If not &TFPrensaNombre_Sel.IsEmpty()
		print printBlockTFPrensaNombre_Sel
	Else
		If not &TFPrensaNombre.IsEmpty()
			print printBlockTFPrensaNombre
		EndIf
	EndIf
	If not &TFInsumoProductoNombre_Sel.IsEmpty()
		print printBlockTFInsumoProductoNombre_Sel
	Else
		If not &TFInsumoProductoNombre.IsEmpty()
			print printBlockTFInsumoProductoNombre
		EndIf
	EndIf
	If not &TFComercialProductoNombre_Sel.IsEmpty()
		print printBlockTFComercialProductoNombre_Sel
	Else
		If not &TFComercialProductoNombre.IsEmpty()
			print printBlockTFComercialProductoNombre
		EndIf
	EndIf

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

EndSub

Sub 'PrintColumnTitles'

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */

	print printBlockBeforeGrid
	print printBlockLines_titles

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

EndSub

Sub 'PrintData'

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */

	For each DB.PrensaProducto
		order PrensaProductoId  when &OrderedBy = 1
		order PrensaNombre  when &OrderedBy = 2 AND &OrderedDsc = False
		order (PrensaNombre)  when &OrderedBy = 2 AND &OrderedDsc = True
		order InsumoProductoNombre  when &OrderedBy = 3 AND &OrderedDsc = False
		order (InsumoProductoNombre)  when &OrderedBy = 3 AND &OrderedDsc = True
		order ComercialProductoNombre  when &OrderedBy = 4 AND &OrderedDsc = False
		order (ComercialProductoNombre)  when &OrderedBy = 4 AND &OrderedDsc = True
		
		using listarPrensaProductoDS(&FilterFullText, &TFPrensaNombre, &TFPrensaNombre_Sel, &TFInsumoProductoNombre, &TFInsumoProductoNombre_Sel, &TFComercialProductoNombre
					, &TFComercialProductoNombre_Sel)

		Do 'BeforePrintLine'
		print printBlockLines_data
		Do 'AfterPrintLine'
	EndFor

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

EndSub

Sub 'LoadGridState'

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */

	// Load grid state from session.
	If &Session.Get(!"Produccion.listarPrensaProductoGridState") = !""
		&GridState.FromXml(LoadGridState.Udp(!"Produccion.listarPrensaProductoGridState"))
	Else
		&GridState.FromXml(&Session.Get(!"Produccion.listarPrensaProductoGridState"))
	Endif	

	&OrderedBy = &GridState.OrderedBy
	&OrderedDsc = &GridState.OrderedDsc

	For &GridStateFilterValue in &GridState.FilterValues
		Do Case
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"FILTERFULLTEXT"
				&FilterFullText.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFPRENSANOMBRE"
				&TFPrensaNombre.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFPRENSANOMBRE_SEL"
				&TFPrensaNombre_Sel.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFINSUMOPRODUCTONOMBRE"
				&TFInsumoProductoNombre.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFINSUMOPRODUCTONOMBRE_SEL"
				&TFInsumoProductoNombre_Sel.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFCOMERCIALPRODUCTONOMBRE"
				&TFComercialProductoNombre.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFCOMERCIALPRODUCTONOMBRE_SEL"
				&TFComercialProductoNombre_Sel.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
		EndCase
	EndFor

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

EndSub

Sub 'BeforePrintLine'

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */



	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

EndSub

Sub 'AfterPrintLine'

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */



	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

EndSub

Sub 'PrintFooter'

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */



	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

EndSub

=== Procedure: Produccion.listarPrensaProductoGetFilterData ===

--- Source (Source) ---

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */

&Options = new()
&OptionsDesc = new()
&OptionIndexes = new()
LoadWWPContext.Call(&WWPContext)

Do 'LoadGridState'
Do Case
	Case &DDOName.ToUpper() = !'DDO_PRENSANOMBRE'
		Do 'LoadPrensaNombreOptions'
	Case &DDOName.ToUpper() = !'DDO_INSUMOPRODUCTONOMBRE'
		Do 'LoadInsumoProductoNombreOptions'
	Case &DDOName.ToUpper() = !'DDO_COMERCIALPRODUCTONOMBRE'
		Do 'LoadComercialProductoNombreOptions'
EndCase

&OptionsJson = &Options.ToJson()
&OptionsDescJson = &OptionsDesc.ToJson()
&OptionIndexesJson = &OptionIndexes.ToJson()

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */


Sub 'LoadGridState'

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */

	// Load grid state from session.
	If &Session.Get(!"Produccion.listarPrensaProductoGridState") = !""
		&GridState.FromXml(LoadGridState.Udp(!"Produccion.listarPrensaProductoGridState"))
	Else
		&GridState.FromXml(&Session.Get(!"Produccion.listarPrensaProductoGridState"))
	Endif	

	For &GridStateFilterValue in &GridState.FilterValues
		Do Case
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"FILTERFULLTEXT"
				&FilterFullText.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFPRENSANOMBRE"
				&TFPrensaNombre.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFPRENSANOMBRE_SEL"
				&TFPrensaNombre_Sel.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFINSUMOPRODUCTONOMBRE"
				&TFInsumoProductoNombre.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFINSUMOPRODUCTONOMBRE_SEL"
				&TFInsumoProductoNombre_Sel.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFCOMERCIALPRODUCTONOMBRE"
				&TFComercialProductoNombre.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFCOMERCIALPRODUCTONOMBRE_SEL"
				&TFComercialProductoNombre_Sel.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
		EndCase
	EndFor

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

EndSub

Sub 'LoadPrensaNombreOptions'

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */

	&TFPrensaNombre = &SearchTxt
	&TFPrensaNombre_Sel.SetEmpty()
	For Each DB.PrensaProducto
		Order PrensaId
		using listarPrensaProductoDS(&FilterFullText, &TFPrensaNombre, &TFPrensaNombre_Sel, &TFInsumoProductoNombre, &TFInsumoProductoNombre_Sel, &TFComercialProductoNombre
					, &TFComercialProductoNombre_Sel)

		&count = 0
		For Each DB.PrensaProducto
			Order PrensaId
			&count += 1
		EndFor
		If not PrensaNombre.IsEmpty()
			&Option = DB.PrensaNombre
			
			&InsertIndex = 1
			Do while &InsertIndex <= &Options.Count AND &Options.Item(&InsertIndex) < &Option
				&InsertIndex = &InsertIndex + 1
			EndDo
			&Options.Add(&Option, &InsertIndex)
			&OptionIndexes.Add(trim(&count.ToFormattedString()), &InsertIndex)
		EndIf
		If &Options.Count = 50
			Exit
		EndIf
	EndFor

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

EndSub

Sub 'LoadInsumoProductoNombreOptions'

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */

	&TFInsumoProductoNombre = &SearchTxt
	&TFInsumoProductoNombre_Sel.SetEmpty()
	For Each DB.PrensaProducto
		Order InsumoProductoId
		using listarPrensaProductoDS(&FilterFullText, &TFPrensaNombre, &TFPrensaNombre_Sel, &TFInsumoProductoNombre, &TFInsumoProductoNombre_Sel, &TFComercialProductoNombre
					, &TFComercialProductoNombre_Sel)

		&count = 0
		For Each DB.PrensaProducto
			Order InsumoProductoId
			&count += 1
		EndFor
		If not InsumoProductoNombre.IsEmpty()
			&Option = InsumoProductoNombre
			
			&InsertIndex = 1
			Do while &InsertIndex <= &Options.Count AND &Options.Item(&InsertIndex) < &Option
				&InsertIndex = &InsertIndex + 1
			EndDo
			&Options.Add(&Option, &InsertIndex)
			&OptionIndexes.Add(trim(&count.ToFormattedString()), &InsertIndex)
		EndIf
		If &Options.Count = 50
			Exit
		EndIf
	EndFor

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

EndSub

Sub 'LoadComercialProductoNombreOptions'

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */

	&TFComercialProductoNombre = &SearchTxt
	&TFComercialProductoNombre_Sel.SetEmpty()
	For Each DB.PrensaProducto
		Order ComercialProductoId
		using listarPrensaProductoDS(&FilterFullText, &TFPrensaNombre, &TFPrensaNombre_Sel, &TFInsumoProductoNombre, &TFInsumoProductoNombre_Sel, &TFComercialProductoNombre
					, &TFComercialProductoNombre_Sel)

		&count = 0
		For Each DB.PrensaProducto
			Order ComercialProductoId
			&count += 1
		EndFor
		If not ComercialProductoNombre.IsEmpty()
			&Option = ComercialProductoNombre
			
			&InsertIndex = 1
			Do while &InsertIndex <= &Options.Count AND &Options.Item(&InsertIndex) < &Option
				&InsertIndex = &InsertIndex + 1
			EndDo
			&Options.Add(&Option, &InsertIndex)
			&OptionIndexes.Add(trim(&count.ToFormattedString()), &InsertIndex)
		EndIf
		If &Options.Count = 50
			Exit
		EndIf
	EndFor

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

EndSub

--- Rules (Rules) ---
/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */

parm(in:&DDOName, in:&SearchTxt, in:&SearchTxtTo, out:&OptionsJson, out:&OptionsDescJson, out:&OptionIndexesJson);

/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */


=== WebPanel: DB.ViewPrensaProducto ===

--- Start (Event) ---
If not IsAuthorized(&PgmName)
		NotAuthorized(&PgmName)
	Endif
	For each
		Where PrensaProductoId = &PrensaProductoId
		Form.Caption = PrensaProductoId.ToString()
		ViewAll.Link = WWPrensaProducto.Link()
		&Exists = True
	When none
		Form.Caption = "Record not found"
		ViewAll.Visible = false
		&Exists = False
	Endfor
	&LoadAllTabs = false
	If &Exists
		&SelectedTabCode = &TabCode
		Tab.ActivePageControlName = &SelectedTabCode
		Do 'Load Tab'
	Endif

--- Tab.TabChanged (Event) ---
&SelectedTabCode = Tab.ActivePageControlName
	&LoadAllTabs = false
	Do 'Load Tab'

--- Rules (Rules) ---
parm(in:&PrensaProductoId, in:&TabCode);


=== WebPanel: DB.WWPrensaProducto ===

--- Start (Event) ---
If not IsAuthorized(&PgmName)
		NotAuthorized(&PgmName)
	Endif
	Grid.Rows = 10
	&Update = "GXM_update"
	&Delete = "GX_BtnDelete"
	Form.Caption = 'Prensa Productoes'
	Do 'PrepareTransaction'
	Grid.LoadSessionState()

--- Refresh (Event) ---
Grid.SaveSessionState()

--- Grid.Load (Event) ---
&Update.Link = PrensaProducto.Link(TrnMode.Update, PrensaProductoId)
	&Delete.Link = PrensaProducto.Link(TrnMode.Delete, PrensaProductoId)
	PrensaProductoId.Link = ViewPrensaProducto.Link(PrensaProductoId, "")

--- 'DoInsert' (Event) ---
PrensaProducto(TrnMode.Insert, nullvalue(PrensaProductoId))

=== Procedure: Produccion.ObtenerConfiguracion ===

--- Source (Source) ---
FOR EACH DB.Configuracion
	WHERE ConfiguracionKey = &ConfiguracionKey
	&ConfiguracionValor = ConfiguracionValor
	EXIT
WHEN NONE
	new 
		ConfiguracionKey = &ConfiguracionKey
		ConfiguracionValor = ''
	endnew
	commit
ENDFOR

--- Rules (Rules) ---
PARM(IN:&ConfiguracionKey, OUT:&ConfiguracionValor);

=== Transaction: DB.Configuracion ===

--- Start (Event) ---
/* Generated by Work With Pattern [Start] - Do not change */
	[web]
	{
	If not IsAuthorized(&PgmName)
		NotAuthorized(&PgmName)
	Endif
	
	&TrnContext.FromXml(&WebSession.Get(!"TrnContext"))
	
	If &Mode = TrnMode.Delete
		btn_Enter.Caption = "GX_BtnDelete"
		btn_Enter.TooltipText = "GX_BtnDelete"
	EndIf
	}
	/* Generated by Work With Pattern [End] - Do not change */

--- After Trn (Event) ---
/* Generated by Work With Pattern [Start] - Do not change */
	[web]
	{
	If (&Mode = TrnMode.Delete and not &TrnContext.CallerOnDelete)
		WWConfiguracion()
	Endif
	
	Return
	}
	/* Generated by Work With Pattern [End] - Do not change */
